source.license: No license stated; one attributed sentence cited

attack_force_n.note: von Wachenfelt, Nilsson and Ventorp 2011, SLU report 2011:20, English conclusions. About 500 stall kicks against a measuring wall, often unprovoked, not fighting; the peak was 8722 N and the authors think horses can kick harder. Range is +/-25%.

attacks_per_s.note: No published attack rate found for this animal; category default.

armor_0_1.note: armor level 1: fur, feathers, or bare skin.

endurance_s.note: Category default (mammal). The gallop distance in the Gallop article is not fighting endurance (D-47).

aggression_0_1.note: aggression level 2: flees first, fights when cornered.

group_tactics_0_1.note: group tactics level 2: lives in groups, but responds to danger by running and kicks alone.
